porteur.definition: The person who will use the travel pass. They can be different from the person who pays.

payeur.definition: The person who pays for the subscription — a parent, an association, an employer…

forfait.definition: A transport subscription, valid for a set period (month, year…).

tst.definition: Solidarity Transport Pricing: support that lowers the price based on your income.

amethyste.definition: A reduced-fare pass for people with a recognised disability (MDPH).

cgvu.definition: General Terms of Sale and Use — the rules for using the service.

zones.definition: The Paris region is split into 5 fare zones, from Paris (1) to the outer ring (5).

boursier.definition: A student receiving a grant (CROUS), eligible for a reduced fare.

mdph.definition: The French departmental office that officially recognises a disability.

franceConnect.definition: The official service to log in online using your government accounts (taxes, CAF…).
